description: This file contains utility functions and a command-line interface for managing a registry of unimplemented function calls related to graph break handling in a PyTorch Dynamo context. It includes functions for loading/saving registries, generating unique IDs, cleaning strings, expanding hints, extracting info from AST nodes, and creating a registry from code analysis.

methods.name: get_source_segment
methods.description: Returns the source code segment corresponding to an AST node from the source string.

methods.name: load_registry
methods.description: Loads a JSON registry from a given file path if it exists.

methods.name: save_registry
methods.description: Saves a registry dictionary to a specified file path in JSON format.

methods.name: next_gb_id
methods.description: Generates a unique GB ID in the range GB0000-GB9999 not present in the registry.

methods.name: clean_string
methods.description: Normalizes string literals by removing formatting artifacts and escape sequences.

methods.name: expand_hints
methods.description: Expands hint references to their actual values by executing external hint definitions.

methods.name: extract_info_from_keyword
methods.description: Extracts the value of a keyword argument from an AST node, handling constants and f-strings.

methods.name: find_unimplemented_calls
methods.description: Scans Python files in a directory or file for calls to 'unimplemented' functions and extracts info.

methods.name: create_registry
methods.description: Creates a registry JSON file from unimplemented function calls found in code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line interface entry point for managing the graph break registry.
